segment.name: SMB
segment.systems: Duck Creek (partial rollout) · PAS B · Rater_BOP.xlsm (VBA) · Appetite_Matrix_SMB.xlsx · ISO + amendatory forms · state portals / SERFF
segment.operatingPattern: Small-commercial package business mid-migration to Duck Creek: BOP runs on the new product model where rolled out, while commercial auto and contractors still quote on PAS B with a VBA rater and spreadsheet appetite guide on the side.
segment.distribution: Independent agents via agent portal, select wholesale brokers, direct digital for micro-BOP
segment.placement: Single admitted package or monoline policy per insured; multi-line accounts stitched manually
segment.reinsurance: Casualty per-risk XoL and property cat treaty; facultative on TIV over $10M — back-end only
segment.regulatory: Admitted in all live states; ISO loss costs with filed loss-cost multipliers and company exceptions via SERFF and state portals

behavior.Product Taxonomy: Duck Creek carries a real product model (XML) for migrated products; PAS B products are config rows, and the master product list is a slide deck nobody trusts.
behavior.Coverages: Migrated coverages live in Duck Creek coverage config; PAS B coverages are coverage-master rows, and rater-only options exist solely inside Rater_BOP.xlsm tabs.
behavior.Terms: Limit/deductible options are Duck Creek picklist config for BOP and hard-coded dropdowns in the VBA rater for contractors — the two disagree on deductible ladders.
behavior.Rating: ISO loss costs plus filed LCMs; Duck Creek rating worksheets for BOP, VBA rater formulas for contractors, PAS B rating service for commercial auto — three engines, one actuarial team.
behavior.Pricing: IRPM/schedule credits are underwriter-entered within filed ±25% bounds; fees, TRIA charges and surcharges differ by engine and are reconciled monthly in a spreadsheet.
behavior.Underwriting Rules: Appetite lives in Appetite_Matrix_SMB.xlsx by class code; Duck Creek referral rules automate part of it for BOP, while PAS B relies on the matrix plus underwriter memory.
behavior.Forms: ISO commercial forms plus state amendatories; attachment rules are Duck Creek config for BOP and a FORMS tab in the rater for contractors, with PDFs in the shared forms library.
behavior.Filings: ISO adoptions, LCM and exception filings per state through SERFF and state portals; the Duck Creek config version implementing each approved filing is tracked by hand.
behavior.Lifecycle Behavior: BOP quotes straight-through in Duck Creek when no referral fires; PAS B lines quote in the portal with rater uploads, and premium audit closes the loop on auditable casualty lines.

items.livesIn: Forms library carrier form CPKG-BR 01; PAS B attach with BR-COC

items.name: State amendatory endorsements (12 states)
items.description: Per-state GL/IM amendatories with statutory cancellation text.
items.livesIn: Forms library state set; PAS B attach STATE=xx mandatory

components.name: Filings
components.expression: 12-state ISO adoption + company IM/BR independent filings

items.name: ISO GL loss cost adoptions (12 states)
items.description: Adoption filings for current ISO GL loss costs in each live state.
items.livesIn: SERFF CARR-CPKG-xx-2025 adoption series; Filings_Log rows

items.name: GL LCM filings (1.45–1.72)
items.description: Company multiplier filings per state supporting v3 GL rate level.
items.livesIn: SERFF LCM filings; rater LCM lookup mirrors approved values

items.name: Independent IM rate pages
items.description: Company-developed inland marine rates filed independently (IM largely non-ISO), including installation and tools rates.
items.livesIn: SERFF IM filings; rate pages in filings folder + Rater CPKG-IM tab

items.name: Builder's risk program filing
items.description: Filed BR program (completed value and reporting form rules and rates) in the 11 states requiring it.
items.livesIn: SERFF CARR-CPKG-xx-2025-BR series

items.name: Form filings — v3 endorsement set
items.description: Filings for the blanket AI/waiver forms and per-project aggregate adoption.
items.livesIn: SERFF form filings; Filings_Log rows

items.name: Rater-to-filing conformance checks
items.description: Quarterly reconciliation that Rater_BOP.xlsm CPKG formulas match filed rates — a manual control after a 2024 mismatch incident.
items.livesIn: Product ops conformance checklist; reconciliation workbook in filings folder

components.name: Lifecycle Behavior
components.expression: Portal + rater quote, subjectivity-gated bind, audit close-out

items.name: Quote — portal application + rater upload
items.description: Agent completes the application in the portal and uploads the CPKG rater output; PAS B validates version and premium match.
items.livesIn: PAS B — quote service CPKG; rater upload validator

items.name: Bind with subjectivities
items.description: Bind is conditional on subcontractor certificates and signed TRIA election within 30 days, tracked as subjectivities.
items.livesIn: PAS B — subjectivity tracker; diary escalation to underwriter

items.name: Certificate and AI issuance
items.description: Certificates with CG 20 10 / CG 20 37 or blanket AI wording issue from the certificate module against contract requirements.
items.livesIn: PAS B — certificate module; AI schedule table

items.name: Project endorsements — add jobsite / add BR project
items.description: Mid-term project adds endorse the installation floater schedule and BR project list with pro-rata or reporting-basis premium.
items.livesIn: PAS B — transaction catalog TXN-CPKG; BR reporting form intake

items.name: Monthly BR reporting cycle
items.description: Reporting-basis builders submit monthly project value reports; missed reports revert projects to completed-value billing.
items.livesIn: PAS B — reporting workflow; delinquency rule

items.name: Renewal cycle at -60 days
items.description: Renewal prep 60 days out with refreshed payroll estimate, loss runs and appetite re-check.
items.livesIn: PAS B — renewal job RNWL-060 for CPKG

items.name: Premium audit at expiration
items.description: Payroll/subcost audit within 90 days of expiration; audit premium bills or refunds as an AP transaction, disputes route to product ops.
items.livesIn: PAS B — audit workflow; audit vendor integration

items.name: Cancellation — pro-rata company / short-rate insured, audit still runs
items.description: Mid-term cancellation triggers an interim audit on the GL section; state commercial notice days apply from the notice table.
items.livesIn: PAS B — cancellation service; interim audit trigger
